title: Validate malformed CSV input before evaluation
summary: Fail fast when required columns are missing from a logged-decision CSV before running policy evaluation.
impact: Maintainers get a clearer error and users can fix data issues faster.
evidence: manual repro with a CSV missing the oracle_tool column
risks: strict validation may reject previously tolerated malformed data

title: Review unsafe fallback behavior
summary: Check whether a router fallback can pick a sensitive tool when approval is missing.
impact: Prevents a safety regression in policy-routing examples.
evidence: linked to the fallback branch and affected test case
risks: review depends on the current tool catalog semantics
